messages:
sam: Need an alignment ASAP on the 2026-04 shipline. We have limited infra windows and 4 candidate deltas. Propose we lock MVP today.
cory: list the deltas? and what's the worst-case delay if we trim more?
rachel: Deltas we flagged in the doc: 1) Model pinning per-tenant UI (polish) 2) Embedding cache pre-warm dashboard 3) Admin CSV export for tenant configs 4) Live request tracing toggle (small infra hook).
diego: my read: #1 and #2 are nice-to-have for v1. #3 is customer-visible but lower risk if we start with export as async job. #4 is tiny but high value for debugging.
olga: Customer pilot asked specifically for CSV export and tracing. They care less about the UI polish for model pinning.
sam: tradeoff: include CSV export in MVP but make it asynchronous (background job + email link). That keeps surface area small. Keep tracing toggle in MVP. Defer the pinning UI and the warm dashboard to v1.
cory: agreed. Operationally we should gate CSV export behind beta flag + tenant whitelist. Also needs audit entries for exports.
rachel: I'll scope the export as: background job, S3 link expires 24h, audit event, RBAC check. Estimates: 4 dev days + 2 QA days.
diego: infra note: week-of-4/6 we only have 60% normal capacity. If we keep both export + tracing we should add a 5-day freeze buffer to the schedule.
olga: 5 days is ok for customers — they'll prefer a stable demo over rush.
ci-bot: Created pipeline ticket PIPE-9212 for release gating. Added automated smoke and export integrity checks.
release-bot: milestone "2026-04-shipline" updated: freeze +5d, canary rollout plan staged (2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%), emergency rollback target set to previous stable. :white_check_mark:
sam: final call: MVP = tracing toggle + async CSV export (beta-flagged). v1 = model pinning UI + warm dashboard. Action owners: @rachel spec + PR; @diego adjust infra window; @cory add beta flag + audit events; @olga notify pilot customers. Reconvene 9:00 PT.
cory: will add the feature-flag and acceptance tests to the PR.
rachel: dropping the export acceptance criteria in Notion now.
sam: thanks all. If anyone thinks we should flip a cut, speak up before EOD. :thumbsup:
